fact: The national financial inclusion agency (ANPFI) stated on 6 November 2026 that the rate of use of financial services reached 79.04% in 2023 and stood at 81.8% at the end of December 2025, above the 75% target of the first strategy.
title: Burkina : 44,2 milliards de FCFA mobilisés pour atteindre 90 % d'inclusion financière en 2031
